previous_statement: Universal ledger. Let C_nest,e_nest; C_out,e_out; e_zero; C_ca,e_ca; and the two amplified-compression thresholds be the universal witnesses in the correspondingly named registered externals. The registered external lem-maincb-error-improvement supplies the universal finite c_0^cb appearing in the hypotheses (no replacement of the already supplied v_U,v_V is needed). Set C_cross=max{1,C_nest,C_out,2*C_ca} and choose e_cross>0 below 1/2, e_nest, e_out, e_zero, e_ca/2, both original-ambient amplified-compression thresholds divided by 2, and both target-corner amplified-compression thresholds divided by C_nest+2*C_ca. This is a positive universal choice, independent of every dimension, amplification, partition, and block algebra.
